_doc: Studio workflow versions for the dashboard #workflow page and /api/productions/<id>/progress. Steps are a catalog; each version lists its flow (an inner array = steps that run in parallel), loops and per-step overrides. Gate thresholds are NOT stored here: `gate` names a key of config/gates.json (single source, packages/shared/src/gates.ts). soft_gates = playbook bars that no code enforces yet.

script_rounds_max.label: Script rounds max
script_rounds_max.where: script:approve (script-doctor.json round); over the cap = orchestrator decides

qa.label: QA rubric
qa.where: review:add verdict pass, no blockers; approve needs the latest QA pass

viral.label: Viral check
viral.where: approve: latest vN/qa/viral.json (story.json productions, not kids)

retention.label: Retention
retention.where: QA Retention section (Mission Voices / Podium Pop)

video_rounds_max.label: Video QA rounds max
video_rounds_max.where: orchestrator rule (CLAUDE.md): round 2 with score < 78 = keep or shelve

packaging.label: Packaging score
packaging.where: script:approve (packaging.json score + chosen_title; code-enforced, audit #2 F10)

radar.label: Viral radar
rules: Every idea starts from a signal <= 14 days old or a real evergreen search line
No signal and no demand line = idea parked
Showrunner reads the latest radar file before the draft brief

next.command: npm run -s cli -- idea:add ... (trend_evidence from the radar signal)

brief.label: Draft brief
rules: Moments / selection / ranking with timestamps
Cite signal_id or evergreen in brief.json
Topic lanes: MV = human astronaut moments, WIM = named hardware, Podium Pop = football stars + stunts

sources.label: Sources + rights
rules: YouTube is discovery-only: never download from it
rights:set "proposed by <tag>"; rights-scout countersigns every new source
Check primary pages, not Commons tags

analyze.label: Analyze
rules: GPU transcription in .venv-asr (python, never python3)
8-20 candidates per long-form source, 20-50 per ranking topic
Every score carries evidence

hook.label: Hook
rules: 3 options that differ by mechanism, pick 1
T1 glance · T2 mute pull · T3 honest payoff
payoff_ts = where the promise is paid; no bait

story.label: Story
rules: One-sentence spine; every beat has a job and a but/therefore link
Open loops with pay times, mid-payoff, one peak
Ending reframes the hook; honest comment trigger + send reason

script.label: Script
rules: Written on story.json + the chosen hook card
Podium Pop: comedy-voice-writer drafts, punchline-critic scores
persona-keeper check for Podium Pop / quiz-ar
Claim -> evidence lines; never AI-generation text in descriptions

next.command: write the script files (script.json / quiz.json / episode.json)

packaging.label: Packaging
rules: 3 titles from real search terms; chosen_title required
Cover = frame 0; description line 1 <= 90 chars
Packaging score /100 with gap_to_gate fixes
Part of the script round; gate 85; packaging.json is the publish source

doctor.label: Script doctor
rules: Spine test, every line has a job, read-aloud at TTS speed
Viral FORECAST (docs/viral-check.md) must reach the gate
gap_to_gate items must sum to the gate (or say ceiling)
Runs FIRST each round (cheap-first); FE + panel only once forecast >= 85

fresh_s.label: Fresh eyes (script)
rules: Zero context: reads only the script export (scripts/fresh-eyes-export.py)
What is it in 1 s, when would I swipe, would I share
Verdict hate blocks
Starts only after script-doctor forecast >= 85; weak verdict needs fix-ledger answers

panel_s.label: Panel (script)
rules: 5 personas from the channel's real audience (docs/audience/<brand>.md)
Blocks at 3+ hate/boring or 3+ swipe before the payoff
Lists issues + gap_to_gate fixes
Starts only after forecast >= 85; >= 2 swipes before payoff needs fix-ledger answers

script_approve.label: Script approve
rules: Only `script:approve` writes script-approval.json
Hash lock on the brand script files: any edit = new script round
Round over the cap = orchestrator decides (rework / shelve) or --force --note
`--delta` for video-round script fixes (recheck changed lines; FE/panel only if hook/payoff/ending changed)

build.label: Build (TTS + render)
rules: Builders refuse without an approved script-approval.json whose hash matches
packages/render: chunked h264_nvenc; master -14 LUFS, <= -1.6 dBTP
Draft modes (--no-tts / --plan) spend nothing and cannot pass stage qa
Every build passes --reason; 4th build without new QA = stop and ask the orchestrator
4th build since the last QA-reviewed version is REFUSED (hard stop, owner 2026-11-08); --force --note logged

next.command: npm run -s cli -- build <id> --agent <showrunner>  (quiz:build / kids:build / tech:build / celebrity:build)

techqa.label: Techqa + prelint
rules: techqa: black / freeze / silence, loudness, answer-leak guards
prelint: captions vs ASR, frame 0, claims, credit wording, AI text, mojibake, text safety (vN/qa/text-safety.json)
Fix every finding before staging

stage_qa.label: Stage qa
rules: Code guard: story.json + script-doctor pass + script approval + passing prelint + passing text-safety.json
Own frame check before staging

qa.label: QA rubric
rules: 100-point rubric on the real MP4, timestamped defects + gap_to_gate
Re-runs T1/T2/T3 on the render (T3 no = blocker)
<= 12 frames at 360 px; re-QA = listed defects + regression diff

next.command: review the latest render -> npm run -s cli -- review:add <id> ...

insights.label: Insights score
rules: YouTube-insights rubric (frame 0, text 0, ...) on the latest version
Approve refuses below the gate

viral.label: Viral check
rules: Will a stranger stop, stay, finish and talk?
Hard gate only with story.json; Sunny Hill = record only
Record-only until 2026-11-22, then bar set from real-view calibration; forecast_delta logged; shelve at video round 2 if viral < 65 (PAUSED until 2026-11-22, owner)

retention.label: Retention
rules: Retention section inside QA for Mission Voices / Podium Pop (retention-reviewer retired)
Rules R1-R8 from the owner's Studio data

next.command: Retention section in the same QA pass

rights_cs.label: Rights countersign
rules: Countersign every new source; again when windows / quotes change
Per render: sha / copy lint, not a full re-view
Network TV, contractor reels and citizen-processed imagery get overturned

fresh_v.label: Fresh eyes (video)
rules: Reads <= 12 frames at 360 px + the transcript only
Verdict hate blocks approval

text_v.label: Frame text check (video)
rules: Code: every build measures every on-screen text in Chrome -> vN/qa/text-safety.json (clipped, offcanvas, unsafe_margin, ui_zone, too_small, overlap, rtl; config/text-safety.json)
Reads text-safety.json + <= 16 frames at 360 px at each text's first/last moment
Any cut / unreadable / UI-covered text = blocker; approve needs text-check.json pass:true (new loop)

Audit #2 F6a (2026-11-08): frame-text-inspector checks only what code cannot measure (text over faces/subject/payoff, readability by eye, unmeasured[], painted layers, burned-in text) and skips items text-safety passed; approve accepts text-safety pass alone when nothing is unmeasured and there are no painted layers

next.command: npm run -s cli -- text-safety <id>  -> write productions/<id>/v<N>/qa/text-check.json

panel_v.label: Panel (video)
rules: Same 5 personas on the render
Blocks at 3+ hate/boring or 3+ swipe before the payoff (kids too)

approve.label: Approve
rules: Latest QA pass (no blockers), insights and viral at their gates
New loop: panel V not blocked, fresh-eyes V not hate
New loop: vN/qa/text-check.json pass:true (frame-text-inspector)
All sources countersigned; approve only on {"ok":true}
Code checks reviewed version = approved version and rights countersign
Story loop: Podium Pop cut-judge / quiz-ar puzzle-judge pass at stage V, or stage C/P pass with input_sha256 = review:hash (unchanged input -> stage V skipped)
Target: 2 approved videos per channel per day (config/gates.json daily_target_approved; /api/throughput)

publish.label: Schedule + publish
rules: Daily uploader / owner's Chrome; explicit OK per post (Podium Pop auto-schedules 4/day)
Title/description/hashtags from packaging.json (fallback script.json); credits from the rights record; no AI-generation text
One shared YouTube Cloud quota across all channels

learn.label: Learn
rules: Turn each published video into the next decision within 48 h
Write 24 h / 7 d results back into the radar signal
Lessons become SR rules and QA checks
analytics-snapshots 24h/72h/7d daily; scripts/calibrate-scores.py Mondays -> research/calibration/; FE vs panel agreement at 20 videos

escalate.label: No-progress escalation
rules: Forecast gains < 3 points over 2 rounds, or round >= 4 with forecast < 75: orchestrator decides rework or shelve
Fix ledger (fix-ledger.json) when fresh-eyes weak or panel swipes >= 2
Numbers in docs/gates.md
